short_description: A 5-day Kindergarten unit on foundational coding framed around Bot the Robot Programmer and Buggy the Debug Beetle. Children move with directions, describe positions, record codes, and find bugs.
long_description: Bot the Robot Programmer and Buggy the Debug Beetle teach Kindergarten coding! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Kindergarten unit covers all 3 B11 expectations (B11.1-B11.3). Day 1 introduces DIRECTIONAL words (forward, back, left, right). Day 2 introduces POSITIONAL words (above, below, beside, between). Day 3 records step-by-step CODE with arrows and pictures. Day 4 TESTS code and finds BUGS. Day 5 closes with a Big Programmer Capstone. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a K trap: hand-side mix-up, up-down confusion, order, no-test, rushed station), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 3-row summative rubric, and Junior Programmer K certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Kindergarten teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day coding unit (B11.1-B11.3).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on, body-first coding with character-driven robot frame, structured pair work, and progression from physical movement to picture code.
